result.instructions: Tools for Microsoft Dynamics 365, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open opportunities are worth more than 50,000 and close this quarter?"; "Show the last five cases opened for the Contoso account."; "Create a contact for Jane Doe at Contoso and link her to the account.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Microsoft Dynamics 365 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dynamics365_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dynamics365_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dynamics365_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dynamics365_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dynamics365_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the user id, business unit id and organization id that the app user acts as in this environment. Good first call to confirm the connection. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/WhoAmI.

tools.name: dynamics365_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: List Dataverse tables (entity definitions) with their logical name, entity set name and whether they are custom. Use the entity set name in the record tools. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/EntityDefinitions.

tools.name: dynamics365_get_table_columns
tools.title: Get table columns
tools.description: List the columns (attributes) of one table: logical name, schema name, type, and whether it is the primary id or primary name. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='<table>')/Attributes.

table.description: Table logical name, e.g. account, contact, opportunity.

tools.name: dynamics365_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List rows of one entity set with optional column selection, OData $filter, $orderby and $top. If the reply has @odata.nextLink, pass that value as next_link to get the next page (the other options are then ignored). Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>.

entity_set.description: Entity set name, e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities.

select.description: Comma-separated column names to return, e.g. name,revenue.

filter.description: OData $filter, e.g. statecode eq 0 and revenue gt 1000000.

top.description: Maximum rows (1-500). Use @odata.nextLink in the reply to page.

next_link.description: The @odata.nextLink value of an earlier reply from this environment.

tools.name: dynamics365_get_record
tools.title: Get record
tools.description: Return one record by id, with optional column selection. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>(<id>).

entity_set.description: Entity set name, e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities.

select.description: Comma-separated column names to return, e.g. name,revenue.

tools.name: dynamics365_run_fetchxml
tools.title: Run FetchXML query
tools.description: Run a FetchXML query for complex joins, aggregates and link-entities. The root <entity name> is the table logical name. Keep the query under about 4000 characters. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>?fetchXml=...

entity_set.description: Entity set name, e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities.

tools.name: dynamics365_create_record
tools.title: Create record
tools.description: Create one record in an entity set and return the created row. Writes data in the customer's environment. Dataverse Web API: POST /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set> with Prefer: return=representation.

entity_set.description: Entity set name, e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities.

fields.description: Column values by logical name, e.g. {"name": "Contoso"}. Lookups use "<field>@odata.bind": "/accounts(<guid>)".

tools.name: dynamics365_update_record
tools.title: Update record
tools.description: Update the given columns of one existing record. It never creates a record: the request sends If-Match: *, so an unknown id returns an error. Writes data in the customer's environment. Dataverse Web API: PATCH /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>(<id>).

entity_set.description: Entity set name, e.g. accounts, contacts, opportunities.

fields.description: Column values by logical name, e.g. {"name": "Contoso"}. Lookups use "<field>@odata.bind": "/accounts(<guid>)".

prompts.title: Get started with Microsoft Dynamics 365
prompts.description: What you can do with Microsoft Dynamics 365 here, with example requests to try.
